newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING -- Jones Education Networks Inc.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING -- Jones Education Networks Inc.

text.p: Company Name Jones Education Networks Inc
Total Class A shares to be offered 6.9 million
Class A Shrs offered by company 5.8 million
Class A Shrs offered by shareholders 1.1 million
Class A Shrs outstanding after IPO 9,492,175
Class B Shrs outstanding after IPO 2,089,620

Underwriters over-allotment 1,035,000 Class A shrs Business: variety of integrated educational programming, products and service through multiple distribution channels designed to serve the learning needs of adults.

Use of Proceeds: to increase marketing activities relating to the company's networks activities and its education products and services through 1997; to license, develop and produce additional programming for its networks and fund future expenses.
